cpu_kernel: native four-thread Cortex-A53 NEON; input packing included
pl_kernel: GEMM_V2 up to three cores; staging, cache sync, wait/clear and host output copy included
weights: constant_b=True reuses cached BT after first use; constant_b=False retransposes B each run
output_validation: Each CPU and PL result checked before the next path can overwrite it
threshold_rule: largest padded-op count in a contiguous low-op range where CPU is at least 10% faster; otherwise use PL
